name: Pharma Foods International Co Ltd
summary: Pharma Foods International Co., Ltd. is a Japanese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, and commercialization of ingredients for functional foods. Its diverse product portfolio features items such as Pharma-GABA, Bonepep, Ovopron (a specific egg yolk globulin), Delicious Catechin, RunPep, and enriched Folic Acid Egg. Additionally, the company offers iHA, a compound recognized for stimulating the body's hyaluronic acid production. Furthermore, Pharma Foods International Co., Ltd. has entered into a licensing arrangement with Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma Corporation for a novel therapeutic antibody designed to combat autoimmune conditions. The firm was founded in 1997 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Kyoto, Japan.
